title: Udyam Certificate Download PDF: Free Steps for 2026
summary: Download your Udyam (MSME) certificate PDF in minutes with the official free steps. Recover a missing registration number and troubleshoot common issues quickly.
body_markdown:
## **How to Recover a Lost Udyam Registration Number**


In case you have forgotten your Udyam Registration Number, you can recover it on the official Forgot Udyam Registration Number page. Verify with an OTP on the mobile number or email recorded in your application.


Follow these steps:


1.


**Open the recovery page:** Visit the official[Forgot UAM/Udyam Registration Number page](https://www.udyamregistration.gov.in/ForgotRegNo.aspx) .


2.


**Select your registration type:** Choose Udyam Registration. If you have an older Udyog Aadhaar registration, select Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum instead.


3.


**Choose an OTP option:** Select Mobile or Email, according to the contact details recorded in your application.


4.


**Enter your contact details:** Enter the selected mobile number or email address and click Validate & Generate OTP.


5.


**Verify the OTP:** Enter the OTP and click Validate OTP. After successful verification, the portal displays the registered number or numbers.


If you cannot recover your number or no longer have access to your registered contact details, contact the Ministry of MSME’s CHAMPIONS support team at champions@gov.in or +91 8308809334. The official portal lists support hours as Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.


Recover your registration number first, then return to the certificate download process. For example, if you have your registered email but have forgotten your Udyam number, use the recovery page’s email OTP option before attempting to log in.


## **How to Fix Common Udyam Certificate Download Problems**


If you are having issues downloading the Udyam certificate, check your registration details, OTP settings, and browser before trying again. Refer to the following table to identify common issues and the right actions for them.


**Problem**


**Recommended action**


Udyam registration number not found or rejected


Check for typing errors and confirm that you selected the correct registration type: Udyam Registration or legacy Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum (UAM). If you have forgotten your number, use the official recovery facility.


Udyam OTP not received


On the Udyami Login page, enter the mobile number recorded in your application, then select whether to receive the OTP on that number or at your registered email. If the OTP does not arrive, wait briefly, then request it again.


Verification code rejected


Enter the verification code exactly as displayed on the Udyami Login page, then try again.


Lost access to registered mobile or email


Refer to the previous section, How to Recover a Lost Udyam Registration Number, for official MSME support options.


Certificate PDF will not open or download


Try opening the certificate again, check your browser's download permissions, or use an updated browser or PDF reader. If the certificate opens but does not save, choose Save as PDF in your browser's print dialog.


Official portal is unavailable


Try again later and access the service through the official Udyam Registration Portal. Avoid entering your registration details on unofficial websites.


For example, if the portal does not accept your Udyam Registration Number, check that it follows the format UDYAM-XX-00-0000000, including the hyphens. Then confirm that you selected the correct registration type.


**Note:** Udyam Registration is free. Use the official government portal and avoid unofficial websites claiming to be the official service.


Check your registration details, OTP delivery option, verification code, and browser settings to troubleshoot a Udyam certificate download problem. If the issue persists, use the recovery facility for a forgotten number or contact official MSME support for other account-related issues.


## **How to Download an Old Udyog Aadhaar Certificate**


Use the official Udyog Aadhaar print page to print or reprint an old certificate. Enter your **12-character Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum (UAM) number** , such as **DL05A0000001** , and the mobile number recorded on the certificate.


UAM is a legacy MSME registration record, separate from the current Udyam Registration Certificate.


**Follow these steps for a Udyog Aadhaar certificate download:**


1.


Open the official[Udyog Aadhaar print page](https://udyamregistration.gov.in/UA/PrintAcknowledgement_Pub.aspx) .


2.


Enter your 12-digit UAM number.


3.


Enter the mobile number recorded on your Udyog Aadhaar certificate.


4.


Follow the instructions displayed on the page to print your certificate.


If you need current MSME registration, visit the official Udyam Registration Portal and select UAM Migration to Udyam. Printing an old UAM record does not update it to a Udyam Registration Certificate. Check whether the old record meets the requirements of the organisation requesting proof of registration.


Let’s say a buyer asks for your current Udyam registration proof, but you only have an older UAM certificate. Print the old certificate for reference, then complete the UAM migration process on the official portal to get your updated Udyam registration.


Use the official print page for a copy of an old UAM certificate. For current Udyam registration, select UAM Migration to Udyam on the official portal.


## **How to Verify or Update a Udyam Certificate**


You can verify a Udyam certificate online, update your registration details through the official portal, and keep your information current without routine renewal.


-


**Verify Udyam certificate:** Open the official verification page and use **Verify Udyam Registration Detail** to check the registration details. You can also scan the certificate’s dynamic QR code to access the enterprise details on the official portal.


-


**Udyam certificate update:** For an MSME certificate update, use the portal’s Update/Cancel Udyam Registration facility, log in as instructed, and follow the steps to update your registration details.


-


**Renewal:** Udyam Registration does not require routine renewal. However, update your details when they change to keep your registration information accurate.


For example, a buyer asks you to prove your registration. Share your Udyam certificate so the buyer can scan its dynamic QR code and view your enterprise details on the official portal.


## **Receiving Payments From Foreign Clients? Keep Your Remittance Records**


When receiving payments from foreign clients, organise your invoices, payment references, and remittance documents. A Udyam certificate does not replace applicable tax, GST, or export compliance requirements.


A[Foreign Inward Remittance Advice (FIRA)](https://www.infinityapp.in/blog/what-is-fira-its-importance-for-freelancers-in-india) proves you received foreign currency in India. It can support GST export benefit claims and tax filing.


**What to save for each payment:**


-


**Invoices:** Keep copies of invoices sent to foreign clients.


-


**Payment records:** Save payment references alongside the corresponding invoice.


-


**FIRA:** In Infinity, open a settled payment and select Download FIRA, as shown in the FIRA download guide.


**If your business receives payments from overseas clients, start**[receiving international payments with Infinity](https://dashboard.infinityapp.in/auth/signup) **.**


## **Frequently Asked Questions About Udyam Certificate Download**


### **1. Is Udyam certificate download free?**


Yes. You can download your Udyam Registration Certificate for free through the official Udyam Registration Portal. You do not need to pay a third-party website to download your certificate.


### **2. Can I download my Udyam certificate using Aadhaar?**


No, Aadhaar alone is not enough to download an existing certificate. The portal's download process requires your Udyam Registration Number, the mobile number recorded in your application, and OTP verification through your registered mobile or email. If you have forgotten your number, use the official Udyam Registration Number recovery page or follow the steps in our Udyam Registration Number recovery section.


### **3. Can I download my Udyam certificate without my registered mobile number?**


Yes, if you can access your registered email and receive the OTP there. You must still enter the mobile number recorded in your application on the login page. If you cannot access either registered contact method, refer to the support options in our Udyam Registration Number recovery section.


### **4. Do I need to renew my Udyam certificate?**


No. Udyam registration does not require routine renewal. Update your registration details on the portal when your business information changes.


### **5. Can I download or verify another business's Udyam certificate?**


You can verify another business’s registration through the official verification facility or its certificate’s dynamic QR code. But you cannot download its complete certificate through the standard login process without the business’s registration details and OTP verification.


### **6. How much time does it take to download a Udyam certificate?**


If your Udyam Registration is complete and your certificate is available, downloading or printing it usually takes a few minutes, depending on OTP delivery and portal response time. If you have just applied for registration, the certificate may take longer to become available.
